mentions.name: envoluntary
mentions.description: A direnv-like utility that hooks into the shell to let developers use Nix flakes for dev environments and dev shells in any project, bridging declarative package installation via NixOS / home-manager with per-project flake.nix / nix-direnv definitions.
mentions.problem: Most projects don't use Nix, creating a gap between installing packages declaratively via NixOS / home-manager and defining them per project via flake.nix / direnv / nix-direnv.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made a direnv-like utility which hooks into your shell to allow using Nix flakes for dev envs / dev shells anywhere:

https://github.com/dfrankland/envoluntary
